children.value: > Fact From Story: India were playing underdogs Kenya in the last-four stage match in Durban on March 20.
> > Fact From Story: India could easily beat Kenya by 91 runs.
> > > Fact From Story: In reply, Kenya were no match for Indian dominance, and barring their skipper Steve Tikolo, who top-scored with 56 runs, no Kenyan batsman could score more than 29 runs.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Underdogs are expected to perform worse than their opponents.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A team beating another team by 91 runs is an example of dominance.
> Commonsense Knowledge: The semi-finals are the last-four stage of a tournament.
